children: PHINIA reported net sales of $912M and net earnings of $67M for the quarter, compared with $908M and $13M, respectively, a year earlier. Diluted EPS was $1.8, up from $0.33.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Earnings per share— diluted”.
Nine-month sales rose 5% to $2.73B, supported by volume, foreign currency and the SEM acquisition.
Nine-month Aftermarket Solutions sales increased 6% to $1.04B, while Power Systems sales grew 5% to $1.69B.
Gross margin for the first nine months improved to 22.3% from 21.9%, as supplier savings and tariff recoveries offset employee costs.
PHINIA completed its acquisition of the stoba Group on October 1, 2026, expanding its business portfolio.
Management expects earnings and cash generation to improve in 2026, with foreign exchange, efficiencies and share gains expected to offset softer original-equipment demand.
